summary: Web regression PASS after splitting (tabs) layout into native NativeTabs (_layout.tsx) and web GlassTabBar (_layout.web.tsx). Metro bundled cleanly (Bundled 7445ms, 1486 modules, exit 0) with 0 bundling errors from the split. Full E2E on Expo web (390x844): onboarding (lets-find-it -> show-me -> name-input 'Nishant' -> create-account -> thats-me -> surprise-me -> camera-not-now -> location-maybe-later) -> Home renders floating glass tab bar with all 3 tabs (tab-home, tab-adventures, tab-profile, each count=1). Tapping tab-adventures shows the Adventures picker (Mystery/Discovery/Chaos/Random). Tapping tab-profile shows Profile with 'Nishant', The Detective, day streak/missions/Lv3 stats, XP, Change my style, Reset Scavvy. Tapping tab-home returns to Home (start-adventure-button visible). Regression full loop: START ADVENTURE -> Mission Reveal (find-it-button) -> Camera 'web-demo-find-button' -> Analyzing -> Mission 1 hit Failure path, try-again-button clicked, second attempt Success -> next-mission-button -> Mission 2 Success -> next-mission-button -> Mission 3 Success -> final button -> Adventure Complete (complete-headline visible, 3/3 missions, 320 XP, +1 streak, personality summary + 4 trait bars Explorer 73% / Observation 98% / Curiosity 91% / Chaos 47%) -> complete-home-button -> Home (start-adventure-button + tab-home visible, streak/missions incremented from 4/27 to 5/30). Content is NOT clipped behind the floating GlassTabBar. Zero pageerrors during the whole run. Only pre-existing non-blocking RN Web deprecation warnings observed (shadow*, props.pointerEvents, useNativeDriver on web) — carried over from iteration_1/2. Deprecated packages detected: none new. The regression check for the tab-layout split is successful — nothing broke on web.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated on RN Web (use boxShadow). Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts shadow.soft/card/button used across GlassTabBar.tsx and other screens
'useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing.' Expected on web; consider Platform.OS gate.

action_items: (Optional polish, carried) Migrate theme shadow.* to boxShadow for RN Web.
(Optional polish, carried) Move pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents in GlassTabBar.tsx and camera.tsx.
(Optional polish, carried) Gate useNativeDriver by Platform.OS !== 'web'.
critical_code_review_comments: _layout.tsx correctly imports NativeTabs from 'expo-router/unstable-native-tabs' with 3 triggers matching route names (home/adventures/profile). Colors/tints wired to theme.
_layout.web.tsx keeps custom Tabs with GlassTabBar and headerShown:false — matches iteration_2 behavior. Route names (home/adventures/profile) match the native side, so navigation is symmetric.

Metro correctly picked _layout.web.tsx for the web target — bundling succeeded and the GlassTabBar renders exactly as before (verified by testIDs tab-home/tab-adventures/tab-profile and visual screenshots).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (onboarding + all 3 tabs + full 3-mission loop + Adventure Complete + return Home)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Viewport 390x844. Clear localStorage before onboarding. Because expo-router keeps prior screens mounted on web, ALWAYS use `page.locator(sel).last` (with .wait_for(state='visible')) for stacked mission-flow testIDs (find-it-button, web-demo-find-button, next-mission-button, try-again-button, complete-home-button). Attempt-1 of Mission 1 can hit the Failure path — click try-again-button then web-demo-find-button again to succeed. Native tabs (_layout.tsx) can't be validated on web preview by design; only Expo Go / native builds exercise NativeTabs. Web preview uses _layout.web.tsx GlassTabBar, which was re-validated end-to-end.
